messages:
Maya: Heads-up — a customer reported the console showing another workspace's routing rules in the dropdown :eyes:
Owen: which page?
Maya: Console > Deployments > Routing policies. Logged into workspace org-9 but dropdown included org-8 entries.
Maya: Repro'd locally with a stale session; UI loader requested decorators and got a payload for org-8.
Vikram: can you paste the request headers from the UI loader when it happened?
Maya: ```
GET /api/console/decorators HTTP/1.1
Host: console.redwood.ai
x-workspace-id: 8
x-session: sess_123
Cookie: session=sess_123; workspace=9
```
Owen: that cookie/header mismatch is the clue. The loader reads workspace from cookie then hydrates header, but there was a race during session refresh. We landed a change in PR #492 that tweaked server-side cache keys recently.
Maya: tracing the decorator service: it uses `workspace || 'global'` for cache key so a global cached response can be served to any workspace if header is missing.
Vikram: that's a dangerous default. Immediate mitigations: (1) set `Vary: x-workspace-id` on responses, (2) clear CDN edge cache for `/api/console/decorators`, (3) put `no-store` while we patch.
Maya: I'll open a hotfix to add `cache-control: no-store` and `Vary` header. Pushing quick canary.
Owen: once canary is up, add a telemetry check that compares `payload.workspace` to incoming `x-workspace-id` and increments a counter on mismatch.
SRE-oncall: I can add an alert: mismatch_rate > 0.1% over 5m -> pager. If we see spikes, I'll purge CDN.
Console-bot: deploy triggered by Maya:deploy/decorators-hotfix -> canary 00f3
Maya: canary 00f3 deployed. Logs show two mismatches in 10m; both from the same customer session refresh flow.
Vikram: follow-up: change internal decorator API to require an explicit `workspace` param (no implicit cookie fallback) and include workspace in the cache key. Add integration test for concurrent session refresh path.
Owen: agree. Also want an E2E test that swaps workspace cookie mid-request and verifies no cross-workspace rows rendered.
Maya: created ENG-1247 + PR 517 with tests and patch notes. Linked the telemetry graphs in the issue.
Owen: good triage. Also let's add a short console UX note: when workspace switch is in-flight, show a spinner and block decorator refresh to avoid intermediate inconsistent UI.
Maya: noted — will add to the PR. Thanks for quick responses :heart:
